title: metadata-protocol/spec: the `_drafts` header carries no label, so a draft-only item can only be shown by its machine name (ListDraftsResponseSchema drops the label the repository already reads)
body:
**Filing gate ①: a measured gap at the producer, class (a): authors see machine names where the item has a label.** Reach: Studio and the console's Changes list, for every metadata item that exists only as a draft. Measured by an objectui dev on objectstack-ai/objectui#11862 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11906, report on that card). This side was read in source on objectstack `main` `13aea189`.

**Who acts on it:** objectstack triage, grade and route (spec and metadata-protocol). ⛔ Not a claim. Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` execution seat 1 (`session_01DrKzdPdyLLBW3qpZ4vtk7z`), on its ruling of that dev's open question 1 (the producer carries the label; consumers do not each fetch one).

## What happens

- The maintainer's direction on objectstack-ai/objectui#11862: 「所有地方以标签为主，机器名只作为次要信息」 (labels first everywhere, the machine name secondary).
- objectui now leads with the label wherever one is in hand (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11906). A **draft-only** item has no label anywhere on the client:
  - a permission set just created as a draft reads `technician`, not "Technician";
  - a draft-only object reads `repairs_repair_ticket` in the nav editor;
  - a new draft in the Changes list reads by name.
- The only list of draft-only items the client has is `GET /meta/_drafts`, and its rows carry no label.

## Where it comes from (read in source)

- `ListDraftsResponseSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, about `:1779`) declares each draft row as `type`, `name`, `organizationId`, `packageId`, `updatedAt` and `updatedBy`. There is no `label`.
- `SysMetadataRepository.listDrafts` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts`, about `:1264`) already reads the whole `sys_metadata` draft rows and maps them down to that header, so the label is in hand at the producer and dropped there.
- `protocol.ts`'s `listDrafts` (about `:22645`) passes the header through.

## Done when

- Each `_drafts` row carries the item's label, taken from the draft's own body. It is `null` when the body declares none, and never a fallback invented by the producer.
- `ListDraftsResponseSchema` and the protocol's declared return agree, pinned as the schema test already pins the current shape (`protocol.test.ts`, "ListDraftsResponseSchema declares the pending-drafts body"). objectui's `MetadataDraftHeader` (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`) follows on its side.
- objectui reads it after the pin bump that carries it. That half stays on objectstack-ai/objectui#11862 (blocked on this card), and objectui adds no per-surface read for a label in the meantime.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectstack, *listDrafts drafts header carries no label draft-only item shown by machine name*: 4 hits, all closed and none about the header's fields (objectstack-ai/objectstack#11087, #8908, #10377, #8858).
- *ListDraftsResponseSchema label field pending drafts body*: 2 hits, the same #8908 and #11087.

Dedupe words: drafts header label · listDrafts label · _drafts row no label · draft-only item machine name
